_comment_bullets: Each experience and project entry has an id and a list of bullets. A bullet has a fixed 'default' text (fact-checked, never altered) and optional 'variants' (alternate wordings you have approved). The tailoring agent may reorder the bullets inside an entry and pick the default or one variant for each; it can never invent a bullet or change a number. Add, remove or reword entries freely: nothing in the code depends on how many there are. Keep the text of each default identical to your real resume. Put your real version in resume_bullets.seed.json (see data/README.md).

experience.context: One line about the company, shown in italics under the role (or null).

bullets.default: Example bullet: Led an end-to-end project that shipped X, improving Y by Z%.
variants: Example bullet: Owned an end-to-end project shipping X, improving Y by Z%.
